subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Is the reporter's wrapper trace enough to treat this as an OpenClaw-owned managed Claude CLI runtime bug, or should maintainers require a live macOS LaunchAgent/MCP reproduction before changing auth or runtime policy?
rationale: The source path matches the report, but the failing condition depends on Claude CLI OAuth, LaunchAgent service context, live loopback MCP, and credential state that this read-only review could not reproduce safely.

options.title: Require live managed-vs-service replay proof
options.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent repro that compares managed gateway execution with same-service Claude CLI replay before changing code.

options.title: Patch from source trace
options.body: Treat the wrapper trace as sufficient and sponsor a targeted fix in the Claude CLI backend/auth boundary, accepting higher risk around auth-env policy.

options.title: Fold into broader Claude CLI OAuth policy work
options.body: Track this under the wider Claude CLI OAuth refresh/dead-end cluster if live proof shows the same expired-token refresh policy rather than a distinct MCP or service-context bug.

recommendation.title: Require live managed-vs-service replay proof
recommendation.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent repro that compares managed gateway execution with same-service Claude CLI replay before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits make this owner the strongest current-history match for the Anthropic plugin, Claude CLI backend, and auth-runtime surfaces involved.
